workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: The employee contract year shall be 196 days and is a ten (10) month contract.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: 7 hours and 30 minutes (8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. with 1 hour for lunch)
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: the duty day shall be a maximum of seven (7) hours and thirty (30) minutes consecutively

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: Planning periods are provided for the purpose of instructional planning.

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: One class period (middle/high schools); 45 consecutive minutes or two 30-minute blocks (elementary)
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: Employees in the middle, high schools and schools instructing adults, shall be scheduled a planning period equal in length to one (1) class period... Elementary school employees shall have a non-student contact planning period of forty-five (45) consecutive minutes, or two (2) blocks of thirty (30) consecutive minutes

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: an elementary employee shall not be required to forfeit the lesser of either three (3) planning periods or one hundred thirty-five (135) minutes of his/her planning time per month... to attend meetings initiated by the administration
